text:
maria: quick heads-up — starting bring-up for customer Lytica's LoRA v3 on int8 runtime. running a compact quick-eval focused on invoices and small itemized tables.

raj: nice. did you run tokenizer alignment? we previously saw currency token-id offsets.

maria: yes, ran infra/token_align.py against their tokenizer bundle. cmd: 
```
python infra/token_align.py --src models/base-lytica/tokenizer.json --dst customers/lytica/tokenizer.json --out tmp/lyt_token_map.json
```

ci-bot: queued: smoke/1723460011-lytica-int8 (priority: high) :rocket:

oliver: first 20 prompts look ok embedding-wise, but invoice-total extraction shows ~2% drop vs fp16 baseline.

sara: customer flagged amount hallucinations in staging; they require precise totals.

maria: observed 3/50 failures where sign or cents flipped. trying runtime tweaks: disable kv cache prefill and reduce group_size to 128. proposed quant config: 
```
quantization: int8
group_size: 128
act_order: symmetric
kv_cache_prefill: false
```

raj: also try token_fix/lyt-compat branch — patches an off-by-one for currency glyph token ids.

ci-bot: smoke started -> smoke/1723460011-lytica-int8: 0/50 complete.

maria: running quick eval: 
```
python tools/run_quick_eval.py --model base-lytica --lora customers/lytica/lytica-lora-v3 --quant int8 --prompts eval_packs/lytica_invoices.min.json --out /tmp/lyt_eval_1723460011.json --batch-size 4
```

maria: results (50 prompts): 47 pass, 3 amount regressions (cases 12, 27, 44). p95 latency +12% vs fp16, est token compute cost -45%. failing snippet: 
```
input: "Items: $12.99, $3.50, $5.00. Total?"
expected_fp16: "$21.49"
int8_output: "-$21.49"  # sign inverted
```

oliver: sign inversion indicates token ordering/byte-interpretation issue rather than pure quantization noise. token_fix might fix. if not, route invoice endpoints to fp16 for canary.

sara: customer ok with canary provided invoice routes fallback to fp16. include that in rollout notes.

maria: plan: 1) rerun with raj/token_fix + kv_cache_prefill=false; 2) if green, create canary (10% traffic) with enforced fp16 fallback for invoice route; 3) attach eval artifacts + failing prompts to ticket.

raj: add a unit test for currency token sequences to prevent regressions in CI.

maria: added to todo, opening infra/rollout/1723460011 with artifacts. tagging @sara for CS comms. :memo:

sara: will draft customer message and canary plan. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: smoke complete: 50/50. summary: 47 OK, 3 regressions (amount parsing). artifacts: /ci/artifacts/smoke/1723460011/summary.json :white_check_mark:

maria: closing thread; will update rollout ticket with results and canary + fallback config.
